steps.en: Register the plugin in your Vite config
steps.zh: 在自己的 Vite 配置里注册插件

steps.en: Rewrites the React, DOM, server, scheduler and JSX entrypoints to Redact in client and SSR builds
steps.zh: 把 React、DOM、服务端、调度器与 JSX 入口全部改指 Redact
业务代码照旧从 react 导入

steps.en: Renders, streams and hydrates synchronously under a ~23 KB gzip runtime instead of React's ~69 KB
steps.zh: 同步渲染、流式输出并水合，运行时从约 69 KB 降到约 23 KB gzip

value.en: The same React source ships over a runtime about 66% smaller — no rewrite, no compat aliases, one build plugin
value.zh: 同一份 React 源码跑在缩小约 66% 的运行时上——不重写、不配兼容别名，只换一个构建插件

sources: README.md Quick start (pnpm add @tanstack/redact; vite.config.ts with plugins: [redact()] importing { redact } from '@tanstack/redact/vite'; "Keep importing from React: import { useState, Suspense } from 'react'"; "The plugin handles client and SSR builds"; bundle table: Redact 23,311 vs React 19.3.0 69,162 gzip bytes)
